name: outstand-seo
description: One block-editor SEO UI, powered by your engine in the background.

scripts.test:unit:tsf: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd='wp-content/plugins/outstand-seo' env OUTSTAND_SEO_TEST_ENGINE=tsf vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=default
scripts.test:unit:yoast: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd='wp-content/plugins/outstand-seo' env OUTSTAND_SEO_TEST_ENGINE=yoast vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=default
scripts.test:unit:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:unit:tsf && npm run test:unit:yoast
